newsitem.title: ITALY: Pirelli rises after analysts' meeting.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli rises after analysts' meeting.

text.p: Shares in Italy's tyre and cables group Pirelli rose on Friday after an analysts meeting, which although did not reveal anything particularly new, reinforced the positive valuation of the group, analysts said.
They said that the group's presentation would not lead to new estimates for this year, but confirmed hopes for a continued rise in profitability with a profit margin objective of 16 percent for 1999.

At 1340 GMT, Pirelli shares were up 1.71 percent at 3,680 lire in an overall lower Milan market after the shares hit a day high of 3,730 lire earlier. The shares touched a year high of 3,925 lire on May 16.
